svg.title: Five steps to see your statistics: install model-router; use Claude Code 2.1.329 or later with mods turned on, because only the mod records; work as usual and let the agent start subagents; let the rework window close, 30 minutes after a subagent reports or when the session ends; then open /model-router or ask for the model-router report. A cell with fewer than five tasks is a weak signal.
svg.text: Use Claude Code 2.1.329 or later, with mods turned on
Only the mod records: the skills work without it, but nothing is measured.
To check: if /model-router is an unknown command, the mod is not loaded.
Let the agent start subagents: each start counts as one task.
It closes 30 minutes after a subagent reports,
or when you end the session.
or ask for the model-router report
⚪ A cell with fewer than five tasks, or a read-only class, is a weak signal: read it as a hint.
